title: A few steps with no hand to hold by about 15 months
summary: Most children take a few steps on their own by about 15 months.
body: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 15-month page prints takes a few steps on his own. The burst is short. No hand is in the wording. The page files it with what most children do by 15 months. A longer stretch across a room is not this line. A delay past that age is not a verdict from this sentence. Lists published outside the United States can pick another month. Only a brief independent burst counts here, not a trek across a whole room, at 15 months. A brief independent burst, not a trek across an entire room, is the 15-month item.
